sections.heading: C2 — KG hints for Occupant Safety and Distraction Elimination
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG hints for Occupant Safety and Distraction Elimination

FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A01
Gear and scenery build blind spots mirrors miss, while speed changes escape the blind spots of others [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint blind-spots; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F01 and sec10-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A01
Passing hurries through blind zones, while pacing big rigs camps inside them [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint blind-spots; prereq_hint sec10-F02; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F02 and sec10-F03.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A01
Known car zones demand checks at every maneuver, while sun glare demands shades and visors [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint blind-spots; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F04 and sec10-F05.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A01
Everyone buckles before rolling, while lap belts ride hips and low pelvis in pregnancy [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint belting; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F06 and sec10-F07.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A01
Beltless riding draws a primary stop with per-rider fines, while belted riding obeys the front-seat and under-18 law [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint belting; prereq_hint sec10-F06; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F08 and sec10-F09.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A02
Tiny babies face rearward under one year and 20 pounds, while under-six children sit in safety or booster seats [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint child-law; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F10 and sec10-F11.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A02
School-age minors belt or seat everywhere, while no minor rides a pickup bed [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint child-law; prereq_hint sec10-F11; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F12 and sec10-F13.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A02
Staying belted inside beats ejection, while loose riders menace the whole cabin [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint myths; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F15 and sec10-F16.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A02
Near-home roads kill most, while quick-release belts aid escape by keeping you awake [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint myths; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F17 and sec10-F18.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec10-R10 | anchor: A03
Eyes, hands, and mind name the three distraction thieves, while real tasks often commit two at once [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint distraction-kinds; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F21 and sec10-F22.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec10-R11 | anchor: A03
Messages wait for a full off-road stop, while safety crews, emergency medics, and alert receivers stay exempt [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint texting-law; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F23 and sec10-F24.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec10-R12 | anchor: A03
Young license holders face a total call ban short of stopping, while all drivers face primary-offense pullovers [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint texting-law; prereq_hint sec10-F23; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F25 and sec10-F26.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec10-R13 | anchor: A03
Distracted killing tops $1,000 in fines with suspension and homicide exposure, while hands-free bans six phone interactions [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint penalties; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec10-F27 and sec10-F28.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec10-R14 | anchor: A03
Iowa's hands-free rule forbids holding a phone or manually operating it while driving. Calls, texts and dialing require hands-free use or voice activation; video streaming and video calls remain prohibited even when voice-operated. Electronic devices include phones, personal digital assistants, tablets, gaming devices and laptops. [A03]
Why it matters: group_hint hands-free; prereq_hint sec10-F28; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec10-F28 and sec10-F29.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0036]
